name: DNSCrypt Proxy
description: Smart DNS filtering with DNSCrypt. Local resolver on 127.0.0.1:5354 with per-profile blocklists (HaGeZi Light/Normal/PRO/PRO++/Ultimate), wildcard-aware Custom Rules, bilingual WebUI (EN/AR), JSON metrics Dashboard, and offline-capable PWA. Zero telemetry.
author: gasciljh
x-note-version: Mirrors main.go BuildVersion with the 'v' prefix stripped (PWA spec requires plain X.Y.Z).
x-note-shortcuts: No shortcuts. WebUI (9090) and Dashboard (9091) are different origins; a shortcut installed from one origin cannot navigate to the other. Use the in-app Dashboard link (built from runtime_info.dashboard_port) instead.
